title: 第24章 苏念念的第四场
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
钟毅从台上站起来的时候，脸上没有不甘，反而咧嘴笑了一下。

    “你上次在教室门口那招不是侥幸。”

    安槐朝他伸出手。“学长承让。”

    钟毅一把握住他的手，使劲晃了两下。

    “下次再打。”

    说完大步走了。

    安槐走下台，迎面是苏念念灿烂得过分的笑脸。

    “帅啊安槐。”

    “一般。”

    “你就不能痛快地接受一次夸奖？”

    安槐想了想。“好的老大，谢谢老大，老大说得对。”

    苏念念嘴角抽了抽，一拳锤在他胳膊上。

    “欠揍。”

    周围的学生看着全年级第一跟一个一米六的姑娘嬉皮笑脸的样子，表情很精彩。

    有人小声嘀咕。“安槐到底是什么做的，前一秒还在台上碾压七重的学长，后一秒就变成了苏念念的小跟班？”

    “人家乐意，你管得着？”旁边有人接话。

    安槐充耳不闻，拉着苏念念到场边看她接下来的分组。

    中层第三轮的对手名单刷新出来了。

    苏念念的对手是韩青。

    一班的，淬体四重，世家子弟，上次在药池楼碰到过的那个面无表情的女生。

    苏念念看到名字，眼睛亮了。

    “她！上次格斗课我跟她平手的那个！”

    安槐点头。“韩青的风格偏防守反击，不会主动进攻，等你先动手再找破绽。”

    “跟你一个德行。”

    “我不一样。”安槐认真道，“我比较帅。”

    苏念念愣了一秒，随即伸手在他脸上拧了一把。

    “你最近是不是自信心膨胀了？”

    安槐摸了摸被拧红的脸，表情无辜。

    五号台上，苏念念和韩青面对面站着。

    韩青一如既往地面无表情，双手垂在身侧，看起来像是随时可以出手，又像是根本没打算动。

    这种压迫感来自她极度稳定的重心和毫无波动的气息，让人分不清她到底在等什么。

    教官喊开始。

    苏念念没有犹豫，直接上手。

    断岳拳第一式，快速切入近身距离。

    韩青的反应极快，侧身半步让开正面，右手精准地拍在苏念念的拳背上，把她的力道偏转了三十度。

    苏念念的拳头打空了。

    第二拳紧跟着来，韩青再次用同样的手法化解，轻描淡写。

    苏念念一口气打了五拳，没有一拳实打实落在韩青身上。

    台下有人开始窃窃私语。

    “苏念念打不进去？”

    “韩青的防守也太强了吧。”

    安槐站在台边，双手插兜，表情平静。

    他不担心。

    苏念念打了六拳之后忽然停了。

    她往后退了一步，深吸一口气，眼神变了。

    不再是一味往前冲的攻势，而是变成了一种冷静的审视。
content_en:
When Zhong Yi stood up from the stage, his face was not resigned, but instead he grinned.

"What you did at the classroom door last time was not a fluke."

An Huai stretched out his hand towards him."Senior's permission."

Zhong Yi took his hand and shook it twice.

"I'll fight next time."

After speaking, he strode away.

An Huai walked off the stage and was met by Su Niannian's overly bright smile.

"Handsome An Huai."

"Average."

"Can't you just accept a compliment?"

An Huai thought for a while."Okay boss, thank you boss, boss is right."

Su Niannian's mouth twitched and she punched him on the arm.

"Deserves a beating."

The surrounding students looked at the top student in the grade smiling playfully with a girl who was 1.6 meters tall. Their expressions were very exciting.

Someone whispered."What exactly does An Huai do? One second he was crushing the seventh-level senior on the stage, and the next second he became Su Niannian's little follower?"

"You can take care of what others like," someone next to him answered.

An Huai turned a deaf ear and pulled Su Niannian to the sidelines to watch her next grouping.

The list of opponents for the third round of the middle level has been refreshed.

Su Niannian's opponent is Han Qing.

Class 1, fourth level of body tempering, a child of aristocratic family, the expressionless girl I met in Yaochi Tower last time.

Su Niannian's eyes lit up when she saw the name.

"She! The one I tied with in the last fighting class!"

An Huai nodded."Han Qing's style is more defensive and counterattack. He will not take the initiative to attack. He will wait for you to make the first move and then find loopholes."

"I have the same virtue as you."

"I'm different." An Huai said seriously, "I'm more handsome."

Su Niannian was stunned for a second, then reached out and pinched his face.

"Have your self-confidence been inflated recently?"

An Huai touched his red face with an innocent expression.

On stage 5, Su Niannian and Han Qing stood face to face.

Han Qing remained expressionless as always, with his hands hanging by his side. He looked like he could take action at any time, but also seemed like he had no intention of moving at all.

This sense of oppression comes from her extremely stable center of gravity and unwavering breath, making it difficult to tell what she is waiting for.

The instructor shouted to start.

Su Niannian didn't hesitate and started directly.

The first form of Duanyue Fist is to quickly cut into close range.

Han Qing reacted very quickly, stepped sideways and stepped out of the way, and accurately slapped the back of Su Niannian's fist with his right hand, deflecting her force by thirty degrees.

Su Niannian's fist was empty.

The second punch followed, and Han Qing once again used the same technique to resolve it, using an understatement.

Su Niannian punched five times in one breath, but none of them actually landed on Han Qing.

Someone in the audience started whispering.

"Su Niannian can't get in?"

"Han Qing's defense is too strong."

An Huai stood by the stage with his hands in his pockets and a calm expression.

He's not worried.

Su Niannian suddenly stopped after punching six times.

She took a step back, took a deep breath, and her eyes changed.

It is no longer an offensive that rushes forward blindly, but has become a calm examination.
